order_note: No predecessor and no order on this engine. SQL 110 needs the homeowner ledger tables (homeowner_ledger_tokens, homeowner_ledger_check_uploads, homeowner_ledger_events, from the restored Supabase schema) owned by checksops_admin without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. Apply it before the API change that deletes pre-claim links or calls public.aws_public_homeowner_ledger_upload: until then a DELETE by checksops fails with permission denied, and the public upload's direct INSERT is refused by aws_write_homeowner_ledger_check_uploads. SQL 110 grants DELETE on homeowner_ledger_tokens to checksops (no policy change: aws_write_homeowner_ledger_tokens, FOR ALL with aws_can_write_tenant, decides which rows) and creates one SECURITY DEFINER function, EXECUTE checksops only. No later migration replaces it.
